_comment: LOCAL HARNESS STUB - not the upstream file. Upstream helpers/coreAssets.json is ~300kB and lists every core asset per chain; only the handful the local tests exercise are here. `null` is the zero address, which is how native currency appears in a Latch pool key. The `robinhood` block is upstream's verbatim as of 2026-09-12 - note it has NO `null` entry, so on Robinhood a native-ETH leg is not a core asset and addOneToken prices the other leg. LTT1/LTT2 are deliberately absent: they are Latch's own throwaway test tokens and are not core assets anywhere.
